recap.text: Ren kicks her flamethrower to Carl and empties her inventory onto the floor, and the last item is the Knife of Frozen Tears, a small crystal knife that looks like a butter knife. It is made of Sylvan crystal, which is one of four weaknesses Garret has gained by regenerating. Ren tells Garret he will live with Carl, then stabs the knife into his side, and he dies instantly.

beats.headline: The last thing in her inventory
beats.text: With one key left and the building sagging round them, Ren will not fight Carl and Donut for it. She kicks her flamethrower to Carl and empties her inventory onto the floor: rings, clothing, potions, scrolls. The last item she pulls out is a small crystal knife that looks like a butter knife and glints with red light. It is called the Knife of Frozen Tears, she says, made of something called Sylvan crystal. It is not very sharp and not all that valuable, but it can kill Garret. Each time he regenerates he gets another weakness. He is up to four now, and Sylvan crystal is one of them. She breaks at that sentence.
beats.gist: Ren empties her inventory for Carl and Donut and offers a crystal knife that can kill Garret.

beats.headline: Into the side of her pet
beats.text: Garret pushes himself against Ren, whimpering. He is a tummy acher, she explains through tears: practically immortal, and every five deaths he resets to level one and has to bond again. This will be the first time. She tells him he is going to live with Carl and be a good boy, then stabs the knife into his side. He dies instantly, like a switch flipped, and his corpse starts to shrink. His weaknesses so far, she says, are sylvan crystal, consuming hobgoblin sweat, the bite of a rivenwing and consuming undead flesh.
beats.gist: Garret, a tummy acher, whimpers against Ren, who stabs him with the knife and he dies.
